output.span: (ii) A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh.
output.reason: The evidence states that for floating rate business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises (MSE) sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges when the sanctioned amount/limit is up to ₹50 lakh. A sanctioned amount of ₹40 lakh satisfies this limit, and a sanction date of 15 March 2026 is after January 1, 2026.
